SRE Lead: Hey team — following up from the postmortem (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/xyz postmortem-2024-03), I sketched a minimal set of runbook/playbook changes we should land this week. goal is: reduce MTTR for the recurring redis cache-eviction and degraded qps incidents and make escalation clearer.

SRE Lead: Proposed changes: 
- Triage checklist: quick health checks, `kubectl`/prom queries, permissive fallback toggle
- Immediate commands to mitigate (cache warmup, route draining) + safe rollback steps
- Clear escalation path: oncall -> SRE Lead -> Eng Platform -> exec pager for >30m
- Add a diagnostic script to collect heap/GC and redis latency snapshot
- Add pattern notes for recurring incidents + link to prior incidents

SRE Lead: Rough owners and timelines: 
- triage checklist + immediate commands: @Maria G, EOD Thu
- escalation path + contact matrix: @AJ, COB Fri
- diagnostic script (bash + logs): @Tony H, next Tue
- playbook formatting + docs PR: SRE team, next Wed

Maria G: I can take the triage checklist. I'll add explicit `kubectl` commands and the Prom queries. Will also add a one-liner to check prefix cache hit rate.

AJ: I'll handle the escalation path. Suggest we add a 2-step auto-escalation in PagerDuty: 5m to SRE Lead, 15m to Eng Platform, 30m exec. Also add Slack channel + phone fallback.

Tony H: I'll draft the diagnostic script. Will include: ps, jstack if java, `redis-cli latency latest`, and a small curl to the /health endpoint. Example snippet I plan to add:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
echo "collecting process list"
ps aux | egrep 'java|redis' > /tmp/proc.txt
redis-cli -h $REDIS_HOST latency latest > /tmp/redis_latency.txt
curl -sS $SERVICE_HEALTH > /tmp/health.json
```

Maria G: For the `kubectl` part I'm going to add these safe commands:
```bash
# check pods by deploy
kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=api -o wide
# describe one failing pod
kubectl describe pod <pod> -n prod
# drain node (if needed)
kubectl cordon <node> && kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

SRE Lead: Thanks. Two additional asks: 1) add a short recovery checklist for the app team to perform config rollback safely, 2) capture SLO breach calculation so we can assess impact during the incident.

AJ: noted on rollback checklist — I'll add an explicit `revert` play for the infra config repo with a safe window note.

Tony H: I'll include a small SLO snapshot function in the diagnostic script that hits the metrics endpoint and computes 5m error rate.

incident-bot: Reminder: new postmortem follow-up created — runbook-updates epic ticket RED-INF-342 created and assigned. :white_check_mark:

Maria G: Quick question — for the escalation path do we want to include oncall phone numbers in the doc or only PagerDuty links?

SRE Lead: Include both, but redact phone numbers in public docs. Put full contact info in the private playbook (private space).

Oncall Rotation: FYI — I'll add the checklist to the rotation dashboard so next oncall can see it in the morning.

SRE Lead: Cool. Can everyone confirm ownership and ETA? If yes I'll open the PRs and the epic tasks. If any blockers, flag now.

Maria G: Confirmed, EOD Thu.

AJ: Confirmed, COB Fri.

Tony H: Confirmed, next Tue.

SRE Lead: Awesome — I'll create the epic and assign tickets (RED-INF-342, RED-INF-343, RED-INF-344). We'll do a quick sync in tomorrow's 15m oncall handoff to review progress. :thumbsup:
